intent: Show on each delivery request which commit it replaced.

edit.summary:
I added an optional `replaced_commit` string property to `DeliveryRequest` in `delivery/delivery.domain.yaml`. It's meant to show which commit the request replaced in the environment. I also bumped that file's `version` from 7 to 8.

Nothing fills the field yet, so it will show as empty on every request. I didn't change any actions to set it. The environment on a request is only a string, so `request_delivery` can't read `Environment.current_commit`. I also didn't want to guess at what the kernel's deploy reply returns. The natural next step is to set it from `Environment.current_commit` at deploy time, or to add an optional `replaced_commit` param to `record_deployment` if the kernel can supply it. I didn't touch the authoring file or the composition.

findings.problem: The change adds `replaced_commit` to DeliveryRequest, but nothing ever sets it. `request_delivery` does not take it as a param, and the Authoring handoff `deliver_approved_commit` does not carry it. `record_deployment` sets only deployed, refusal and probes_passed, and no action reads `Environment.current_commit` (which also has no action that sets it). Every request will show it empty, so the stated goal of seeing what was running before is not met. The field also needs a way to be filled in at deploy time, for example the kernel reply recording the previous commit, and a redeploy from `done` must not overwrite it with the request's own commit.

The new optional property replaced_commit on DeliveryRequest is never populated. request_delivery has no replaced_commit param, and the authoring handoff deliver_approved_commit does not pass one. record_deployment sets only deployed, refusal and probes_passed, and no other action sets it. Nothing sets Environment.current_commit either, so the previous commit is not tracked anywhere. Every request will show an empty replaced_commit, and the change's goal of showing what was running before is not met.

The change adds the optional `replaced_commit` property to DeliveryRequest, but nothing ever sets it. `request_delivery` does not take it as a param, the Authoring handoff does not pass it, and `record_deployment` and `record_build` do not set it. The deploy call's reply (`record_deployment`) only carries `deployed` and `error`. Every DeliveryRequest will show `replaced_commit` empty, so the stated goal of seeing what was running before is not met.

There is no source for the replaced commit. `Environment.current_commit` is declared, but no action updates it, and no Environment is linked to a DeliveryRequest (`links: {}`). The only Environment fixture has no current_commit. Even if an action were added to fill `replaced_commit`, it would have nothing to read from. The new property also has no source or scenario showing how it is filled.

The new optional property `replaced_commit` is never set. No action has an effect that writes it, `request_delivery` takes no such param, the Authoring handoff does not pass one, and `record_deployment` does not set it. Every delivery request would show it empty, so the stated goal of seeing what was running before is not met.

The only record of what is currently running is `Environment.current_commit`, and nothing in the domain ever sets it. `deploy` and `record_deployment` do not update it, so there is no source for the replaced commit even if an action were added to copy it. The change needs a step that reads the environment's current commit when the deploy is recorded and then updates it.

The new optional property `replaced_commit` is never populated. `request_delivery` takes no such param, the Authoring handoff `deliver_approved_commit` does not pass one, and `record_deployment` and `record_build` have no param or effect that sets it. Nothing sets `Environment.current_commit` either, so the previous commit is not recorded anywhere to copy from. Every request would therefore show an empty field, and the stated goal of seeing at a glance what was running before is not met. The change needs an action or effect that records the replaced commit at deploy time, plus a fixture and scenario showing it.
